camera.source: shots/binoculars-sam/camera.json: phase correlation on the footage; the camera tilts up as the man looks up, so he and the binoculars sink about 25 px in the frame

planes.label: Binoculars (the hands, arms and chin are extra strokes on the drawn keys, carried with the binoculars)

notes.1: the dissolve has ended; the man holds the binoculars to his eyes, tilted a little to his left
notes.8: he begins to tip his head back to look higher; the camera tilts up with him
notes.13: the binoculars come level and sink in the frame
notes.22: the binoculars tilt slightly the other way

no_cel: SAM followed the binoculars for frames 0 to 8 and then the man's hands, so cel paint from the silhouette would cover the hands and not the binoculars
hands_note: The man's hands, arms and chin were scene objects on the char plane; they slid with the measured camera (left) while the binoculars drifted right, so the hands slid against the barrels. They are now extra strokes in shots/binoculars/drawn/k*.json (the same Quick, Draw! hand doodles and agent-drawn arm and chin lines), kept relative to the binoculars so the hands stay on the barrels.
